task: Where can I find Hermès' latest annual report?

merged.claim: Hermès' latest annual report is its 2025 Universal Registration Document (2025 URD), which includes the annual financial report.

variants.A: Hermès International's latest annual report is its 2025 Universal Registration Document (URD), which contains the 2025 Annual Financial Report.
variants.B: Hermès' latest annual report is the 2025 Universal Registration Document, which includes the annual financial report.
variants.C: Hermès' latest annual report is the 2025 Universal Registration Document (2025 URD), which includes the annual financial report.
variants.D: Hermès' latest annual report as of November 11, 2026 is its 2025 Universal Registration Document, which includes the annual financial report.
variants.E: Hermès' latest annual report as of 11 November 2026 is the 2025 Annual Financial Report, included in its 2025 Universal Registration Document (2025 URD).
variants.F: As of November 11, 2026, Hermès' latest annual report is its 2025 Universal Registration Document, which includes the annual financial report.

merged.claim: Hermès International filed its 2025 URD with the French Financial Markets Authority (AMF) on 19 March 2026, in ESEF format.

variants.A: Hermès International filed its 2025 Universal Registration Document with the French Financial Markets Authority (AMF) on 19 March 2026, in ESEF format.
variants.E: Hermès International filed its 2025 Universal Registration Document with the Financial Markets Authority (AMF) on 19 March 2026, in ESEF format.

merged.claim: Under Article 222-3 of the AMF General Regulation, Hermès' URD includes the 2025 Annual Financial Report.

variants.E: Under Article 222-3 of the AMF General Regulation, Hermès' Universal Registration Document includes the 2025 Annual Financial Report.

merged.claim: The 2025 URD includes the 2025 Annual Financial Report, the parent company and consolidated financial statements, the sustainability report, the corporate governance report, and the resolutions for the 17 April 2026 General Meeting.

variants.A: The 2025 URD includes the 2025 Annual Financial Report, the parent company and consolidated financial statements, the sustainability report, the corporate governance report, and the resolutions for the 17 April 2026 General Meeting.

merged.claim: Per Hermès' press release, the 2025 URD is available on finance.hermes.com in the Investors section under Publications > Regulated information.

variants.A: Hermès' press release says the 2025 URD is available on finance.hermes.com, in the Investors section under Publications and Regulated information.
variants.E: The Hermès 2025 URD is available on finance.hermes.com under Investors section > Publications > Regulated information.

merged.claim: Hermès makes the 2025 URD available on its official Hermès Finance website.

variants.D: Hermès makes the 2025 Universal Registration Document available on its official Hermès Finance website.

merged.claim: Hermès Finance's Regulated information page lists the 2025 URD (including the annual financial report) as an e-accessible document dated 19 March 2026.

variants.E: Hermès Finance's Regulated information page lists the 2025 URD (including the annual financial report) as an e-accessible document dated 19 March 2026.

merged.claim: The Hermès finance Publications page lists the 2025 URD as the latest annual report, with a PDF link and a link to the online version.

variants.A: The Hermès finance Publications page lists the 2025 URD as the latest annual report, with a PDF link and a link to the online version.

merged.claim: Hermès' Financial publications page is located at https://finance.hermes.com/en/financial-publications/.

variants.F: Hermès' Financial publications page is located at https://finance.hermes.com/en/financial-publications/.

merged.claim: The English PDF of the Hermès 2025 URD is available at assets-finance.hermes.com (260320_hermes_urd2025_en.pdf).

variants.A: The English PDF of the Hermès 2025 URD is at https://assets-finance.hermes.com/s3fs-public/node/pdf_file/2026-04/1777391712/260320_hermes_urd2025_en.pdf.
variants.D: The Hermès 2025 Universal Registration Document can be downloaded as a PDF directly from Hermès' finance assets site.
variants.E: An official English PDF of the Hermès 2025 URD is available at assets-finance.hermes.com (file 260320_hermes_urd2025_en.pdf).

merged.claim: The English PDF of the Hermès 2025 URD is 19.3 MB.

variants.C: The English PDF of the Hermès 2025 URD is 19.3 MB and is available at assets-finance.hermes.com/s3fs-public/node/pdf_file/2026-04/1777391712/260320_hermes_urd2025_en.pdf.

merged.claim: The official English PDF is titled '2025 Universal Registration Document Including the Annual Financial Report'.

variants.B: The official English PDF of Hermès' 2025 Universal Registration Document is titled '2025 Universal Registration Document Including the Annual Financial Report'.

variants.C: The French version of the Hermès 2025 URD (Document d'enregistrement universel 2025, DEU 2025) is a 17.25 MB PDF posted 19.03.2026 at assets-finance.hermes.com/s3fs-public/node/pdf_file/2026-04/1777391612/260319_hermes_urd2025_fr.pdf.

merged.claim: A digital (online) version of the Hermès 2025 URD is available at hermes.fr.digital-report.net/en/report/5309.

variants.A: An online version of the Hermès 2025 URD is available at https://hermes.fr.digital-report.net/en/report/5309.

variants.C: The Hermès 2025 URD is also available in an e-accessible/digital version, and is featured on the Financial publications page of finance.hermes.com, with a digital version at hermes.fr.digital-report.net/rapport/5260.

merged.claim: Hermès is a French issuer and does not file a separate Form 10-K-style annual report; its consolidated annual report is contained within the URD.

variants.C: Hermès is a French issuer and does not file a separate Form 10-K-style annual report; its consolidated annual report is contained within the Universal Registration Document.

variants.C: An updated e-accessible version of the Hermès 2025 URD (about 304 KB difference, noted on the regulated-information page dated 04.10.2026) may have replaced or supplemented the original PDF.

variants.E: The Hermès 2026 Half-year Financial Report is newer than the 2025 URD but is not an annual report, so the 2025 Annual Financial Report remains the latest annual report.

variants.A: Hermès also publishes half-year reports, which are separate from the annual report.

merged.claim: Hermès usually files its URD in March, so the 2026 URD is expected around March 2027.

variants.A: Hermès usually files its URD in March, so the 2026 URD is expected around March 2027.

merged.claim: Hermès had not filed a 2026 URD as of 2026-11-11.

variants.A: Hermès had not filed a 2026 URD as of 2026-11-11.

c1.note: Hermès' site lists the 2025 URD (including the annual financial report) as the current full-year document; the 2026 report is not yet due.

c2.note: The press release states it was filed with the AMF on 19 March 2026 in ESEF format.

c6.note: The press release cites Article 222-3 of the AMF General Regulation as the basis for including the annual financial report.

c7.note: The press release's content list matches the claim, including the 17 April 2026 General Meeting resolutions.

c8.note: The press release says it is on finance.hermes.com under Investors > Publications and Regulated information.

c10.note: The finance.hermes.com homepage features the 2025 URD with PDF and digital access links.

c11.note: The page lists the URD as e-accessible with date 03.19.2026.

c12.note: The page shows the 2025 URD with 'Access in PDF' and 'Access the digital format' links.

c14.note: The page exists at that URL and the site navigation links to it.

c15.note: The English PDF is hosted at that assets-finance.hermes.com path and is linked from the Hermès site.

c16.note: Regulated-information page lists the English URD PDF as 19.3 MB at the stated path (260320_hermes_urd2025_en.pdf).

c17.note: Hermès titles it '2025 Universal Registration Document (including the annual financial report)'; the press release uses 'Including the Annual Financial Report'.

c18.note: French page lists the DEU 2025 as a 17.25 MB PDF dated 19.03.2026 at the stated 260319_hermes_urd2025_fr.pdf path.

c19.note: The 'Access the digital format' link points to hermes.fr.digital-report.net/en/report/5309.

c20.note: The French publications page links the digital format to hermes.fr.digital-report.net/rapport/5260; the PDF is labelled e-accessible.

c21.note: The press release states the URD includes the annual financial report under AMF Article 222-3, so no separate 10-K-style report is needed.

c22.note: The 304.56 KB figure belongs to a separate voting-rights release dated 04.10.2026, not an updated URD; the URD is listed at 19.3 MB and dated 03.19.2026.

c23.note: The 2026 Half-year Financial Report (07.29.2026) is newer but is interim, so the 2025 URD remains the latest annual report.

c24.note: The regulated-information page lists a separate 2026 Half-year Financial Report dated 07.29.2026.

c25.note: The 2025 URD was filed 19 March 2026; filing in March is the usual pattern, so a March 2027 filing for the 2026 URD is a reasonable expectation, though a forecast.

c26.note: The homepage still features the 2025 URD as the latest, and a 2026 URD would normally be filed in March 2027.

c2.note: Hermès' press release on webdisclosure says the 2025 Universal Registration Document was filed with the AMF on 19 March 2026, in ESEF format. Hermès' own release PDF came back empty, so the date and format rest on that copy.

c5.note: Hermès' regulated-information page lists the 2025 URD, which includes the annual financial report, dated 19 March 2026. No newer URD or amendment is listed as of the run date.
